notes: SoundCloud playback controls are now visible only inside Music; the floating player is hidden during games while shared audio continues. Adds SoundCloud song/artist search inside the Android app using its public search page. Tap a track title or Play button to choose it directly for the music queue without copying a link. Adds a persistent Listen later list with Save current, Save link, search Save for later, Play, Queue and Remove. No room-server deployment is part of this app release; ongoing games are preserved.
